title: Gazebo Pacer
text: Settings for synchronized stepping between Gazebo and Simulink, 1 output; {Reset behavior} sets the reset simulation time or scene Reset Gazebo simulation and {Sample time} sets the sampling time of input. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Reset behavior
params.values: Reset simulation time or scene Reset Gazebo simulation time (default) | Reset Gazebo simulation time and scene
